title: Limelight Networks (LLNW) in Focus: Stock Moves 6.6% Higher
text:
1 / 2 Apple's Vertical Integration Policy To Hurt These 3 Suppliers Apple's (AAPL) aggressive vertical integration policy is creating pressure on its suppliers of late. Limelight Networks, Inc. LLNW was a big mover last session, as the company saw its shares rise nearly 7% on the day. The move came on solid volume too with far more shares changing hands than in a normal session. This stock, which remained volatile and traded within the range of $4.10 –$4.50 in the past one-month time frame, witnessed a sharp increase yesterday.
The shares rose after the company said that it had settled all of its outstanding legal disputes with Akamai Technologies, Inc. AKAM.
The company has seen no estimate revisions over the past one month, and the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current quarter has also remained unchanged. The recent price action is encouraging though, so make sure to keep a close watch on this firm in the near future.
Limelight Networks currently has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) while its Earnings ESP is 0.00%.
